purpose: Assess current applets, applications, emulator services, server space, user space, hardware abstractions, frameworks and governance lanes using evidence-backed deployability rather than claimed telemetry or UI wiring.

focus_surfaces.issue: Displayed as wiring/claims without backend capability receipts.
focus_surfaces.required_correction: Expose explicit task submission, capability envelope, fallback CPU path, evidence receipt, circuit-breaker state and no TPU hardware claim without target receipt.

focus_surfaces.issue: Does not declare user purpose, function, work environment, VFS namespace, task queue, capability set, response contract or proof path.
focus_surfaces.required_correction: Bind worker identity, team, tenant boundary, VFS namespace, queue, skills, policy set, runtime allocation, telemetry channel, receipt ledger and lineage address.

focus_surfaces.issue: Boot claims require BIOS/kernel/rootfs asset receipts, v86 presence readback, serial output and disk/volume mapping receipts before promoted runtime status.
focus_surfaces.required_correction: Classify as emulator runtime with boot asset readback, manifest integrity, VFS volume binding and degraded state when boot assets are absent.

focus_surfaces.issue: Random/generated metrics were presented as capability status.
focus_surfaces.required_correction: Replace random health claims with receipt-backed health state, heartbeat records, circuit-breaker state and explicit simulated/demo labels where applicable.

focus_surfaces.issue: Shell execution endpoints require strict command allowlisting, timeout, path isolation, audit receipts and user-facing response boundaries.
focus_surfaces.required_correction: Gate commands by policy, write execution receipts, keep forbidden operations failed-closed and preserve degraded UI state on backend outage.

focus_surfaces.issue: Icon launch and drag behavior was improved, but a launcher is not itself an applet unless it binds to an executable command and receipt path.
focus_surfaces.required_correction: Every desktop icon must resolve to a K-APP package, route, capability contract, readback status and failure-domain policy.
